mode.label: Saved guidance. Live Muse is off.

no_guidance: This screen has no saved guidance yet.

queue.label: Work queue
queue.guidance: Start with a task that blocks an application. Open the task to compare the records and see the available actions.

prompts.next_step: Open the task that blocks an application. Compare the records before you decide.
prompts.why_review: A task is waiting for a person. The matcher only proposed it; it did not decide it.

incoming.label: Incoming
incoming.guidance: This application is waiting for intake. The recorded findings show which information needs attention.

prompts.next_step: Read the recorded findings, then process the intake for this application.
prompts.why_review: The application has not been through intake yet. A person reads the findings and acts.

match_case.label: Match case
match_case.guidance: Compare the record reference, credential, and unit. Similar names can belong to different organizations.

prompts.next_step: Compare the reference, the credential and the unit. Then confirm the link, reject it or defer it.
prompts.why_match: The matcher ordered the candidates with the recorded agreements and conflicts. The score is an ordering aid, not a probability.
prompts.what_changes: A link changes which master record owns the source values. The source values stay as they are, and no permit is decided.
prompts.why_review: The match is not decided. A steward compares the records before a link is applied.

parcel_case.label: Parcel case
parcel_case.guidance: The locator proposed a property. Check the parcel and unit. The Permit Reviewer still needs to confirm the property.

prompts.next_step: Check the parcel and the unit, then approve or reject the link.
prompts.what_changes: The link sets the property of the application. The address the applicant typed is kept as submitted, and no permit is decided.
prompts.why_review: The parcel link is not decided. The locator proposed it; a person confirms it.

no_candidate.label: No candidate
no_candidate.guidance: No suitable master record was found. Search existing records before requesting a new identity.

prompts.next_step: Search the master records first. If nothing matches, ask the source owner for a correction.

automatic_link.label: Automatic link review
automatic_link.guidance: The automatic linking policy applied this link. Review the recorded evidence or undo the link with a reason.

prompts.next_step: Read the recorded evidence, then keep the link or undo it with a reason.
prompts.why_match: The policy applied this link from the recorded score and the identity checks. A steward reviews it after the fact.

master_collection.label: Master records
master_collection.guidance: Search for a person, organization, property, or permit. Open a record to see its sources and unresolved questions.

prompts.next_step: Search for the record you need, then open it to see its sources and open questions.

record_profile.label: Record profile
record_profile.guidance: Each current value follows its named source policy. Identity status and license status are separate.

prompts.next_step: Check the open questions first. Then look at the value and the source it comes from.

source_record.label: Source record
source_record.guidance: These are the values accepted from the source. A correction must follow the named source route.

prompts.next_step: Compare the accepted values with the master record. Ask the source owner for a correction if a value is wrong.

source_correction.label: Source correction
source_correction.guidance: The accepted value stays unchanged until the source accepts the correction. The response appears in this history.

prompts.next_step: Wait for the source to answer. The answer and its acknowledgement appear in the history.

activity.label: Activity
activity.guidance: Open an event to see who acted, the evidence used, and any later correction.

prompts.next_step: Open the event you need. It shows who acted and what was recorded.

automation_settings.label: Automatic linking settings
automation_settings.guidance: Preview the policy before activating it. A higher score requirement does not replace the identity checks.

prompts.next_step: Preview the policy, then activate it with a reason if the classification is right.

reconciliation.label: Reconciliation
reconciliation.guidance: Account identity, settled money, and payment allocation are separate. Linking an account does not settle a balance.

prompts.next_step: Resolve the account identity here. Settling money stays with the authorized finance workflow.
